newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sanofi in South Africa joint-venture.
newsitem.headline: Sanofi in South Africa joint-venture.

text.p: Sanofi, the health and beauty products company majority-owned by Elf Aquitaine, said it had signed a joint-venture deal with Omnimed (Pty) Ltd of South Africa.
Omnimed is owned by Adrian Pule and Barnie Hurwitz, who is also founder and chairman of Clinic Holdings which is South Africa's biggest private hospital group.
The joint-venture will be called Sanofi Omnimed (Pty) Ltd and Sanofi will have a 51 percent stake. The venture will start operations in early 1997.
It will sell Sanofi products in South Africa as well as new products developed by South African researchers. A clinical study centre is programmed to be opened in Johannesberg.
The 1997 sales of Sanofi Omnimed are expected to be some 30 million francs.
